verdict.rationale: Data portability and export are fair questions for a payments platform, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents exporting all data in open formats or leaving the platform. The docs cover payments, issuing, and multi-currency balances with 'real-time visibility', which is not a bulk-export capability. The breach discussion and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes do not address data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
